_comment: Shaped like the Linear GraphQL API (users, teams with privacy and members, issues). Simplified.

issues.title: Backpressure alerts are noisy for tier-1 tenants
issues.description: IngestBackpressureHigh fires 20+ times a week for tier-1 tenants that are within their raised 200k events per second limit. The alert threshold ignores per-tenant limits. Plan: make the threshold relative to each tenant's configured rate limit. Good first issue for onboarding; pair with Jordan.

issues.title: Atlas: gateway support for schema hints header
issues.description: Accept the X-Kestrel-Schema-Hint header from the Atlas SDK and pass it through to Kafka as a record header. Needed for the Atlas v0.9 beta.

issues.title: Upgrade Kubernetes to 1.32
issues.description: Staging upgrade on Nov 4, prod two weeks later if no regressions. Blockers: the ingress-nginx chart must be bumped to 4.12 first. Rollback plan: keep the 1.31 node pool for 72 hours.

issues.title: Migrate metadata DB to Postgres 16
issues.description: Completed Oct 2 with 4 minutes of read-only downtime. pg_stat_statements is now enabled on all environments.

issues.title: Pen test finding: SSRF in webhook delivery service
issues.description: Critical. The webhook service follows redirects to internal metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254). Fix: block link-local ranges and disable redirect following. Finding id CNRY-LIN-3307. Embargoed until the fix ships.
